reviews.title: The most horrible company out there
reviews.text: There was an overlooking on my flight. They simply ran out of seats and made me wait for the next available flight until the next morning (24 hours). Neither flight nor delay reimbursement was made by the company whatsoever! They didn't even book me in for the next flight until I went personally to the company office. Horrible company and services. If there was a way to give them "minus one", I definitely would.
reviews.author: Svitlana L

reviews.title: Terrible practices
reviews.text: They use a scam payment system for cabin luggage: if it doesn't fit into the tiny box (half of the normal size) you pay 25$ at check-in, but at another mandatory check during boarding it's already 40$. They charge it also if you have e.g. a second plastic bag or hand bag - at this point you can't do anything about it. It's impossible to check in online unless paying for the seat. There's very little leg room and super hard seats.
reviews.author: Julia H

reviews.title: Beware ! Fraud
reviews.text: Tickets cost too much money for low-cost company. Smartavia makes upp own rules for everything! Cabin baggage is half-size of international standards. Stuff is rude and make you pay lots of money on every step of your journey to airplane. They make you pay extra 3,5 thousand for registration, 2,5 thousand rubles for en extra cm cabin baggage, 1000 ruble for your computer etc Otherwise you will be denied boarding! It is like a nightmare quest! Some passengers were charged twice for the same ticket. Airplane is awful. Internet support does not answer your questions/requests. They just copy/paste their rules. Of you want to save you money and happy mood, NEVER fly this company! There are plenty of other similar and terribly detailed reviews in Russian. This company is AWFUL and THE WORST!!!
reviews.author: Nadja T

reviews.title: Constant delays
reviews.text: Flew a couple of times with them - just a typical budget airline but I would like to thank them for constantly delaying their flights from Moscow to Murmansk.. And once it was delayed for about 24h as it allowed my friend to stay over and enjoy Moscow more than expected :) Though of course for someone it could be a great inconvenience..
reviews.author: Lena G

reviews.title: Awful service, nobody cares
reviews.text: Rude, inattentive hostesses. Features you bought on the ticket are ignored and they charge you on the spot. Arbitrary enforcement of carry-ons. Seats are stiff, food is easily the worst I've ever had on a flight. No inflight entertainment. Its impressive how absolutely awful this airline is. Do yourself a favor and fly with any other airline you can.
reviews.author: Flier3957

reviews.title: Pleasant enough, and they feed you, unlike BA
reviews.text: Travelled on business on their 737-500 which the magazine said was about 20 years old. Seats were no worse than any budget airline, announcements in English and Russian, and food and drink was served, free. Both flights were on time, so no complaints.
reviews.author: Qegsboy

reviews.title: No complaints
reviews.text: The flight was on time, the cabin crew friendly and helpful. The plane was clean and there was enough leg room. I didn`t like the 24h in advance online check-in policy.
reviews.author: Lidija_DD

reviews.title: DO NOT EVER FLY WITH THIS COMPANY
reviews.text: We arrived 5 minutes late to gate close and lost the flight. We bought the next ticket at FULL price. But the issue does not start here. At return flight they made us buy another ticket at full price because they cancelled also our return flight. And nobody gave a care about it. So, my experience with this company can be told as "you buy one you pay for two. Wonderful nordavia, Keep stealing money
reviews.author: Antonio

reviews.title: It took us from A to B
reviews.text: From Archangelsk to Solowetsk-Islands. Nothing fancy nor extra. A technical performance. They served tasty tomato-juice during the flight. Instead of 19 hours train and boat trip Nordavia took us in 50 minutes with 120 €, so not a bad deal. 100% Russian language, so be prepared to know at least something in Russian. A positive experience. The destination Solowetsk Island is not mentioned in yhr list, so I choose Murmansk, which is moe or less in that area.
reviews.author: Jartzi-Jarturo

reviews.title: Regular flight, no issues
reviews.text: We took Nordavia flight from St. Petersburg to Tbilisi. We were a bit concerned because of all the negative reviews especially regarding legroom. We were in Russia for the world cup and decided to take a break from the hectic world cup vibe to relax in quieter Georgia. Nordavia was the only convenient option as Georgia Air had weird departure times and the other alternative was to fly to Moscow and then Tbilisi. We decided to go with Nordavia and were surprisingly not disappointed at all. The flight boarded slightly late, about 15min later than original time which wasn't too much of an issue. The flight attendants were friendly and legroom was not as bad as I expected. We found it to be regular for a local / regional flight and the seats were also comfortable. The food was not Emirates standard but it was a 3.5hr flight so we weren't too concerned about that. Overall a pleasant flight with no issues.
reviews.author: Moleboheng N

reviews.title: Below my expectations
reviews.text: Actually there were no legroom! The seat was extremly uncomfortable. Food was very delicious. Staff were friendly.
reviews.author: Shervin Hashemi

reviews.title: Worst Companie Ever! They just dont care about the passengers!
reviews.text: i had a flight the 27 june 2018 from Kaliningrad to Moscow with this companie, the had 2 hours 30 min delayed and because of the delau I missed my flight from Moscow to Barcelona. When i went to Nordavia office, to complain about missing my next flight they JUST DONT CARE ABOUT US! I missed a 1200e flight ticket because of them and they JUST DONT CARE ABOUT US. Not a Hotel, not helping us for another ticket, not even a bottle of water!! We are just stucked here in the Moscow airport! they just gave us a stupid paper!! NORDAVIA JUST DONT CARE ABOUT THEIR PASSAGERS!!
reviews.author: Hicham K

reviews.title: Good connection for DME Moscow
reviews.text: Very clean plane good connection time to DME Moscow from Orenburg Russia food poor but that was reflected in the price of the ticket and since it was less than 2 hour flight no great hardship.
reviews.author: Mike B

reviews.title: Not the most comfortable air carrier.
reviews.text: I flew a flight Murmansk - Moscow - Murmansk. There is not much choice of airlines. Aeroflot tickets are a bit more expensive than the Nordavia, but you will fly by one plane. Little old planes, uncomfortable chairs, rumpled roll with greens and pack nut - that all my memories of the voyage.
reviews.author: 0gik
